description: This Java class defines the HttpClassCallback, a model representing a callback with a class name and type, including builder methods, equality, and hash code implementations, used within the mockserver project.

classes.name: HttpClassCallback
classes.description: A model class for specifying a callback with a class name and type, supporting builder pattern, equality, and hash code methods.
